director.text: 9 wala pizza

Bilkul sahi. 8/9 poore se bas 1/9 kam hai, 6/7 poore se 1/7 kam, aur 1/9 chhota hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
12/7 sahi nahi hai. Dono mein 7 hisse liye gaye; ab dekho kis patti ka ek hissa chhota hai. 7/10 aur 7/12, dono ek jaisi patti ke hain; inmein se chhota kaun hai?
Nahi, 12/7 theek nahi. Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
maine dobara check kiya

Achha, sun liya maine. Aaj dekha ki ek poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse, har hissa utna chhota. Hisse ek size ke hon toh ginti dekhte hain, aur ginti barabar ho toh hisse ka size. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
aasaan laga
Hmm, batane ke liye shukriya. Aaj ke paath mein tumne dekha ki 6/7 aur 8/9 mein poore ke zyada paas kaun. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
